subject: Import clearance & cross-dock capacity alignment for ACME Dedicated onramp
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Wei Zhang <wei.zhang@jintech.com>, Procurement - ACME AI <procurement@acmeai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-11T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Import clearance & cross-dock capacity alignment for ACME Dedicated onramp

Team / Wei –

Following our procurement sync: ACME has committed to a Dedicated pool that needs to be available in staggered tranches starting mid-September. We need to lock down the hardware shipping and an explicit backstop from CloudNova to cover shortfalls during the import/customs window. Key asks: 

1) Wei – can JinTech commit to a ship-by date (not just MFG ETA) for the first tranche of 40 units (A100-equivalent SKUs)? Please call out CIF vs DDP options and realistic customs clearance delta (days) at LA/Long Beach. Identify any single-SKU risk if supply tightens and whether an approved substitute SKU exists.

2) CloudNova – can you provide a regional backfill offer (capacity and per-hour credit) that we can present to ACME as a failover? We need both short-term (air/cloud for first 6 weeks) and medium-term (cloud reserve for 3 months) pricing.

3) Internal – Karthik/Rishi/Marcus: I need a quick sizing confirmation: if we stage 40 units in tranche 1 and 60 in tranche 2, what latency/throughput delta should ACME expect vs their target of 10ms P50 on text-gen? Also note quantization/comp action items.

Attachments: initial OEM quote referenced (please see JinTech to attach updated quote), vendor contact spreadsheet placeholder.

Time is tight here – ACME expects a customer-facing onboarding window in Q4 and procurement will push if we can’t show a concrete plan. Wei, can you reply with concrete ship dates and any expedited freight cost options by EOD Tue?

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Onboarding, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0184

[attachment: request_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)]

From: Wei Zhang <wei.zhang@jintech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement - ACME AI <procurement@acmeai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Import clearance & cross-dock capacity alignment for ACME Dedicated onramp

Vanessa / team –

Thanks for the note. Quick update from JinTech manufacturing and logistics: 

- Manufacturing ETA (board test complete): Aug 20 for tranche 1 (40 units), Sep 10 for tranche 2 (60 units).
- Standard ocean freight + port dwell: we estimate 18–28 days from shipment to customs release at LA. Current port congestion adds a 7–10 day variance; we recommend planning for worst-case 38 days.
- DDP (door delivery) option available; adds ~5 business days of lead-time internally but removes customs risk on your side. We can quote DDP vs CIF.
- SKU substitution: we have a compatible MPN (JX-A100L) that is pin-compatible but differs on memory bandwidth. If we need to substitute, performance delta is about 8–12% on 2048-token jobs — we’ll include benchmark numbers.
- Expedited air freight: available for tranche 1 (partial) at ~3–4x the ocean cost; transit 3–5 days but capacity limited.

I’m attaching an updated OEM quote (jintech_oem_quote_v2.pdf) that lists the ship-by commitment windows and optional air-lift line items. Note that expedited freight requires PO confirmation within 48 hours of the quote.

Actionable: I can provide a CIF ship-by commitment: ship week of Aug 22 for tranche 1 with DDP as an upgrade. If you want DDP, we need to confirm by Jul 16 to secure the slot.

Wei Zhang
Supply Chain Director, JinTech Hardware
wei.zhang@jintech.com
+86 21 5554 9901

[attachment: jintech_oem_quote_v2.pdf (PDF stub)]

From: CloudNova Sales <cloud-sales@cloudnova.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement - ACME AI <procurement@acmeai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Import clearance & cross-dock capacity alignment for ACME Dedicated onramp

Hi Vanessa / ACME team –

We can provide a tiered backstop offer to cover import uncertainty: 

- Short-term: pre-warmed on-demand pools (us-west/us-east) matching A100-equivalent cores up to 50 concurrent instances for first 6 weeks. Discounted rate at 60% of public on-demand while active.
- Medium-term: 3-month reserved capability (guaranteed capacity) with a 20% platform credit applied to net usage for the duration if active.
- Marketplace link: https://marketplace.cloudnova.com/redwood-backstop-offer

If ACME is willing to take a blended approach (air freight + short-term cloud backstop) we can offset expedited freight by up to 30% via a one-time credit applied to the backstop consumption. Pricing sheet attached (cloud_backstop_term_sheet.docx).

Let us know which region you prefer for the primary backstop (we recommend splitting 60/40 w/west for latency).

— CloudNova Partnerships
cloud-sales@cloudnova.com

[attachment: cloud_backstop_term_sheet.docx (DOCX stub)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Import clearance & cross-dock capacity alignment for ACME Dedicated onramp

Quick internal calc and recommendation: 

Assumptions:
- Target: ACME expects 10ms P50 for large text-gen.
- Tranche sizing: T1 = 40 units (A100-equivalent), T2 = 60 units.
- If we have to substitute to JX-A100L (OEM alt), expect 8–12% throughput hit on long sequences.

Sizing notes (very rough):
- If we serve 40 units in T1 and put 30 equivalent units in cloud backstop (split 60/40 west/east) we can meet P50 10–12ms for P50 with slight variability during peak.
- Expected token throughput: 1.2B tokens/day for the committed SLA. A hardened dedicated pool (40 units) covers ~70% of baseline, cloud covers the remaining 30% peak.

Operational asks: 
- Procurement: confirm whether ACME accepts a mixed delivery (DDP for critical tranche + CIF for remainder). If yes, we authorize JinTech to tentatively reserve DDP slots.
- Finance: sign off on up to a 30% freight uplift if air-lift is used for tranche 1.

Marcus / Lauren — are you OK to present the mixed plan to ACME (DDP + Cloud backstop + contingency substitution)? We should include a short appendix with the substitution perf delta.

Karthik
Director, Dedicated Capacity Ops
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Date: 2028-07-18T16:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Import clearance & cross-dock capacity alignment for ACME Dedicated onramp — decision & next steps

Thanks everyone — consolidated next steps below. Sharing this to make the plan explicit for ACME procurement and our legal/finance teams.

Decision summary (approved):
- Tranche 1: 40 units — proceed with CIF ship week of Aug 22, convert to DDP for critical 20 units if ACME confirms PO by Jul 16. JinTech will hold the DDP slots conditionally.
- Tranche 2: 60 units — standard ocean, ship target Sep 10, monitor port queue weekly.
- Backstop: CloudNova to provision pre-warmed pools (50 instances) for first 6 weeks. Use 60/40 west/east split. CloudNova to apply 30% credit to offset any expedited freight we use.
- Substitution: JinTech's JX-A100L approved as conditional substitute; include the 8–12% perf delta in the onboarding SOW.

Action items & owners: 
- Vanessa: update ACME procurement thread and copy legal on SOW appendix (due 07/19).
- Wei (JinTech): finalize DDP vs CIF cost table and confirm DDP slot hold (due 07/16 as requested).
- CloudNova: send final term sheet with regional identifiers and the one-time credit mechanics (due 07/17).
- Karthik/Rishi: produce short perf appendix showing expected P50/P95 with substitution and with cloud backstop (due 07/19).
- Marcus/Lauren: prepare commercial summary for ACME (discounts, freight uplift approval) and confirm finance sign-off for 30% freight uplift contingency (due 07/20).

Attachments included: jintech_oem_quote_v2.pdf; cloud_backstop_term_sheet.docx; customs_contacts_USP_ports.csv

I’ll set a 30-minute sync for Fri 07/20 09:00 PT to walk ACME procurement through the risk posture and approvals. DocuSign envelope for the SOW appendix will be pre-populated (link below).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/DEAL-2027-049
DocuSign (SOW appendix draft): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-REDWOOD-ACME-0728

Thanks — please flag any items you think should move earlier.

Vanessa Ortiz
